LanguageData.LP_PactScenario.label: pactmaker
LanguageData.LP_PactScenario.description:
A mortal pactmaker, a satyr who followed from the Feywild, a cambion with abyssal blood, and a manes chained to this world by a planar anchor chain. You hold three pact scrolls from different patrons; whichever you sign, the price won't be small.

This is the only start that lets you pick pact races during character creation: devils of the Nine Hells (chain devil, bone devil, horned devil, erinyes, amnizu), the fey courts (satyr, dryad, redcap, changeling), celestial emissaries (deva, planetar), abyssal demons (manes, barlgura, hezrou, succubus, nabassu, shadow demon, cambion), plus ice devils and balors. These races don't appear in the xenotype dropdown of other starts; wild hunt riders and wild hunt leaders only appear as enemies and can't be chosen in any start.

The starting outsider colonists all wear planar anchor chains: they aren't banished when downed and leave corpses when they die. Planar contract law (with its prerequisites planar bloodlines and abyssology) is already researched, and you start with an uninstalled pact lectern: take a pact scroll to the lectern and read for 4 hours to review, negotiate and sign.

Note: the costs of pacts are real, and debt attracts debt collectors; outsider colonists are strong, but some races (such as balors and planetars) are far stronger than ordinary starts; a high-freedom start where the balance is up to you.

LanguageData.LP_PactScenario.scenario.parts.GameStart:
The wax on the pact scrolls is still warm.

Three patrons have heard your name: one in the ledgers of the Nine Hells, one in the moonlight of the fey court, one somewhere even farther. The anchor chain on the manes's foot clinks, the satyr plays an off-key flute nearby, and the cambion stares at the scrolls with fire reflected in its eyes.

Set up the lectern first. Read every word clearly, especially the very small ones.
LanguageData.LP_PactScenario.scenario.summary: A pactmaker, a satyr, a cambion and an anchor-chained manes, three pact scrolls and a pact lectern; pact races can be chosen during character creation.
